extracted.intended_audience: museum professionals, grant program staff, evaluators, and policymakers (IMLS/Museums for America stakeholders)
extracted.subtask_short: IMLS Museums for America grant evaluation
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of evaluation metrics and outcome criteria used in the IMLS/Museums for America (MFA) project evaluation report (tables of project characteristics, audience/programming/community/partnership/organizational outcomes, by activity area, museum size, and award amount).

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of audience groups served
rubrics_metrics.description: Count, mean, median, minimum, maximum of audience groups served by project, reported by primary activity area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in Table IV-2 as numeric summary statistics (count, mean, median, min, max) by primary activity (Programming, Exhibitions, Digitization/Collections, Technology/Online Resources, Organizational Development, Total).

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of audience served (internal vs external)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether project served internal audiences only (museum staff) or external audiences (public), with number and percent by primary project area and museum discipline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-3 breaks out projects by museum discipline and whether audiences served were internal audiences only or external audiences; percentages and counts reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of age groups served
rubrics_metrics.description: Count, mean, median, minimum, maximum of distinct age groups served by project, reported by primary activity area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-5 presents numeric summaries of the number of age groups served for each primary activity area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presence of specific age groups served
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether projects served preschool or younger, post high school/young adults, adults, seniors, and multi-age/families (Yes/No, counts and percentages by primary activity area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-4 reports, for each primary activity, the number and percent of projects serving each age category (Yes/No) and totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: School-aged children grades served (K-5, 6-8, 9-12)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether projects serve school-aged children and specifically which grade bands (Grades K-5, Grades 6-8, Grades 9-12) with counts and percentages by primary activity area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-4 (continued) reports counts/% of projects serving each school-age band and totals by primary activity area.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one positive audience effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project reported at least one positive effect on audiences (Yes/No, count/% by activity area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-6 reports this binary indicator; significance noted where applicable (* Statistically significant p ≤ .05).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reached new audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project reached new audiences (Yes/No, counts and percentages by primary activity area and by museum size/award amount).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported across Tables IV-6 and IV-8 with counts/%; footnote indicates statistical significance where marked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increased commitment by existing audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project increased commitment by existing audiences (Yes/No, counts/% by activity area and other strata).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-6 and IV-8 present counts and percentages; asterisk indicates statistically significant differences (p ≤ .05).

rubrics_metrics.name: Changes in regular audience participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project produced changes in regular audience participation (Yes/No, counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in Table IV-6 by primary activity area and stratified by size/award in IV-8.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increased audience access
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project increased audience access (Yes/No, counts/% by activity area and other breakdowns).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown in Table IV-6 and IV-8; includes totals and stratified percentages.

rubrics_metrics.name: No effect on audiences (negative/null outcome)
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects reporting no effect on audiences (Yes/No totals and percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as the complement to positive audience effects in Tables IV-6 and IV-8.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extent of success in sustaining new audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: If the grant enabled bringing in new audiences, extent organization has been successful in sustaining these new audiences (Not at all successful / Somewhat successful / Very successful; counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-7 reports the three-level outcome for projects that brought in new audiences, by primary activity area and totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: If grant enabled new programming: extent of success in continuing programming
rubrics_metrics.description: For projects that conducted new programming, extent the organization has been successful in continuing the programs (Not at all successful / Somewhat successful / Very successful; counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-9 and IV-10 present these three response levels, with stratification by museum size and award amount; totals and percents shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one positive programming effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether project reported at least one positive programming-related effect (Yes/No, counts/% by primary activity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-11 reports this indicator for programming/exhibition projects; significance markers included where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-funded programming continued beyond the grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether grant-funded programming was continued beyond the grant period (Yes/No, counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-11 and IV-12 show counts/% and stratifications; used to assess sustainability of program activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustained grant-funded programming (sustained vs did not sustain)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether projects sustained grant-funded programming (Yes/No totals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguished in Table IV-11/IV-12; used together with seeking additional funding and related program development metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sought additional funding to sustain grant-funded programming
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the organization sought additional funding to sustain grant-funded programming (Yes/No, counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-11 reports this measure (and IV-12 stratifies by size/award).

rubrics_metrics.name: Developed related programming to expand value of grant-funded program
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether projects developed related programming to increase value of the grant-funded program (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-11 includes this as an outcome of programming/exhibition projects; significance asterisk applied where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expanded range of possibilities for programs or exhibitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project expanded the organization's range of program or exhibition possibilities (Yes/No, counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in Table IV-11 as a programming/exhibition effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: No changes in programming
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects reporting no change in programming as an outcome of the grant (Yes/No, counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in Table IV-11 as the null/negative programming outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one positive community effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project produced at least one positive community-related effect (Yes/No, counts/% by primary activity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-13 reports this indicator; significance noted for some comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Changed institutional identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project changed the institution's identity (Yes/No, counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-13 lists this community-level outcome; stratified by activity and by size/award in IV-14.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthened museum's public image
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project strengthened the museum's public image (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in Table IV-13/IV-14; asterisk indicates statistically significant differences where shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Raised institution's prestige in the community
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project raised the institution's prestige in the community (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented in Table IV-13 and IV-14 with counts and percentages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increased media coverage of institution's activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project increased media coverage of the institution's activities (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-13/IV-14 provide counts/% and note statistical significance where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increased visibility as a center of community learning
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project increased the institution's visibility as a center of community learning (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-13 includes this community-level outcome with totals and stratifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: No change to profile (community)
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects reporting no change to their profile as a community institution (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in Table IV-13 as the complement to community effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one positive effect due to partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether projects reported at least one positive effect attributable to partnerships (Yes/No counts/% by activity area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-15 reports this indicator; star denotes statistically significant results where marked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership: brought in new audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether effects due to partnerships included bringing in new audiences (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-15 and IV-16 present counts/% by activity area and stratified by size/award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership: brought in new resources not normally available
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether partnerships brought in resources not normally available to the organization (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in Tables IV-15/IV-16 with counts and percentages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership: brought in new staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether partnerships resulted in new staff being brought in (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-15 documents this effect among reported partnership outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership: brought in new memberships
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether partnerships produced new memberships for the organization (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in Table IV-15 as an effect due to partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership: raised community awareness of the organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether partnerships raised community awareness of the organization (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-15 shows counts/% for this effect and other partnership outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: No effect due to partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects reporting no partnership-related effects (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as the complement to positive partnership effects in Table IV-15/IV-16.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked with youth organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project worked with youth organizations (Yes/No counts/% by activity area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-17 lists this partnership activity and its prevalence by primary activity area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked with educational institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project worked with educational institutions (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-17 includes this as a partnership activity; counts and percents by activity area are shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked with community organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project worked with community organizations (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in Table IV-17 with prevalence across activity areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked with other museums
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project worked with other museums (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-17 reports this indicator across primary activity areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthened ongoing partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether projects reported strengthened ongoing partnerships as a result of the project (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in Table IV-17; used to measure partnership quality changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developed new/ongoing partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project developed new or ongoing partnerships (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-17 lists this measure and shows counts/% by activity area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improved skills in building partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether projects reported improved skills in building partnerships (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-17 records this organizational/partnership capacity outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increased ability to attract more partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project increased the organization's ability to attract more partners (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in Table IV-17 among partnership capability outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developed new types of partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether projects developed new types of partnerships (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-17 includes this as an outcome metric for partnership innovation/diversification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decreased ability to attract partners (negative partnership outcome)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether projects reported a decreased ability to attract partners as a result of the project (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in Table IV-17 as a rare negative partnership outcome to be tracked.

rubrics_metrics.name: No effect on partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects reporting no effect on partnerships (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as the complement to positive partnership outcomes in Table IV-17.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one positive organizational development effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project reported at least one positive organizational development effect (Yes/No counts/% by activity area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-19 reports this overarching organizational-development indicator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in program development
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project enhanced staff capacity in program development (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-19 provides counts/% by primary activity area and shows statistical significance markers where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in creating new kinds of exhibitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether staff capacity was enhanced for creating new exhibition types (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in Table IV-19 as a specialized organizational development outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in reaching new/larger audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether staff capacity improved for reaching new or larger audiences (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-19 and continued tables report prevalence by activity area and totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in forming external partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether staff capacity improved for forming external partnerships (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed in Table IV-19 as an organizational capacity outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in working across departments
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether staff capacity increased for cross-departmental work (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-19 includes this metric as an organizational development outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in using outcomes-based evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether staff capacity was enhanced for using outcomes-based evaluation (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-19 reports this capacity-improvement outcome; useful for measuring evaluation practice adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improved staff cohesion and commitment to mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project improved staff cohesion and commitment to the institution's mission (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table IV-19 includes this as a staff-related organizational outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Greater alignment of staff responsibilities with mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project resulted in greater alignment of staff responsibilities with the institution's mission (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in the continuation of Table IV-19 as an organizational effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Greater board involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project increased board involvement (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included among organizational outcomes in the report's tables (Table IV-19 continuation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Helped institution fulfill its mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the project helped the institution fulfill its mission (Yes/No counts/%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a high-level organizational outcome in the report's organizational development tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical significance standard used
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparisons in tables are annotated for statistical significance where applicable using '* Statistically significant p ≤ .05'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Asterisked cells/metrics indicate differences that meet p ≤ .05; tables present counts and percentages alongside significance markers.
